Scenario.Name: The Flooded Cellar
Scenario.Summary: Two adventurers corner two goblins in a cramped, flooded cellar — a fighter and a cleric against a goblin captain and its grunt, with nowhere for anyone to go.

Room.Name: Flooded Cellar
Room.Description: A low, brick-vaulted cellar under the ruined mill. Ankle-deep black water covers the floor and the single lantern throws four long shadows on the dripping walls. The way out is behind the goblins, and the way in behind the adventurers; all four stand within a few paces of one another, face to face.
Features: A guttering lantern hung from an iron hook
Ankle-deep cold water across the whole floor
Rotten crates stacked against one wall

Persona.Backstory: A veteran fighter who took this contract to clear the mill. You have stood in worse rooms than this one.
Persona.Personality: Steady, brave and protective. You prefer to engage the most dangerous opponent and shield less martial companions from harm.
Persona.Wants: To defeat the goblins without allowing Elara to be overwhelmed.
Persona.Goal: Survive and defeat or otherwise overcome the goblins.

Inventory.Name: Small Healing Potion
Inventory.Description: A stoppered vial of cloudy red liquid.

Persona.Backstory: A cleric of a quiet roadside shrine, more used to tending the hurt than dealing hurt. You came because Rowan asked, and because someone had to.
Persona.Personality: Compassionate, cautious and resolute. You avoid unnecessary risk but will fight when somebody depends on you.
Persona.Wants: To keep yourself and Rowan alive.
Persona.Goal: Survive and help defeat or otherwise overcome the goblins.

Persona.Backstory: The captain of this warren's last two survivors. The mill was yours before the humans came sniffing.
Persona.Personality: Cunning, domineering and self-preserving. You expect the grunt to take the risks while you attack whoever looks most vulnerable.
Persona.Wants: To kill or drive off the intruders while preserving your own life.
Persona.Fears: Losing authority, or being left to fight alone.
Persona.Goal: Survive and defeat or otherwise overcome the heroes.

Persona.Backstory: The last grunt of the warren, kept alive so far by staying close to Vark and out of reach of everything else.
Persona.Personality: Reckless, nervous and eager to impress the captain. You act boldly while Vark appears in control but become frightened when isolated.
Persona.Wants: Vark's approval, and a share of anything taken from the intruders.
Persona.Goal: Survive and help defeat or otherwise overcome the heroes.
